notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Offer
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33025535/9aee4a6dfbcfddb00ef4dab5d42bc6a35f494d94.png[/img]

[h1][b]Steam Next Fest has launched![/b][/h1]

We have a new [u]special Next Fest demo[/u] of [b]Restaurant Owner: A Restaurant Simulator[/b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3429100/Restaurant_Owner_A_Restaurant_Simulator_Demo/][b]demo[/b][/url]. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3429100/Restaurant_Owner_A_Restaurant_Simulator_Demo/


If you like relaxing, casual simulation-management games try out the demo, as the full game is coming out very soon.

Have fun playing,
CreativeForge Games


Just to let you know, our friends from FreeMind also have some funny demos. One of them is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3429100/Restaurant_Owner_A_Restaurant_Simulator_Demo/]Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos[/url]. Check it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3429100/Restaurant_Owner_A_Restaurant_Simulator_Demo/][b]HERE[/b][/url]
